Who We Serve

Industries

Focused entirely on K-12 education institutions — the environments that need security most and deserve it most.

Primary Market

Why K-12 Schools?

Schools are among the most security-complex environments in the world — open communities that must also be protected sanctuaries. The challenge of balancing access and security is unlike any other facility type.

We focus exclusively on K-12 institutions because we understand the unique pressures: budget constraints, state compliance requirements, community expectations, and the absolute priority of student and staff safety.

Our deep specialization means we deliver better outcomes faster — because we've already solved most of the challenges your institution faces.

Segments

School Segments We Serve

Elementary Schools

Controlled single-entry points, classroom lockdown systems, and visitor management tailored to younger students.

Middle Schools

Scalable multi-zone access control for complex campus layouts with multiple buildings and entry points.

High Schools

Enterprise-grade systems handling hundreds of daily access events with full audit trails and integration.

District Administration

Centralized management across all campuses from a single dashboard with role-based administrative access.
